script_text: Scorpio — your Water element and Pluto collide with intense transits this week. Sun conjoins Mercury in your career 10th House and squares Mars in Taurus Monday, sparking relationship friction that mirrors professional pressure. Tuesday, Moon enters Pisces and trines Jupiter in Cancer, granting emotional clarity and insight. Mid-week pivot: Venus enters your 5th House trining Jupiter in your 9th House Wednesday, unlocking romance and abundance. Late week, Saturn stations direct in Taurus Friday, forcing you to reconcile partnership with career ambition. Weekend Moon floods your 1st House with raw Scorpio intensity, charging confidence and electric magnetism. Wednesday is your best day because Venus enters your 5th House and trines Jupiter, activating love breakthroughs and creative abundance. Thursday is your worst as Saturn stations in Taurus, creating heavy tension between partnership and career. Trust Pluto's ancient, fearless power to transform resistance into unstoppable momentum. Follow for daily updates.
